name: IETF RATS
notes: No axis mapping is published for this standard. This document is a discovery pointer to the live board and the free verifier; it does not assert a correspondence between this standard and any CSOAI measurement axis.

The delegation receipt spec (CC0, v0.1 draft) maps its roles to RFC 9334 and states why it emits no EAR status: /spec/delegation-receipt/CROSSWALK.md. That is a field crosswalk for one record format, not an axis mapping.
